vulnerabilities.description: Implicit missing: AuthGate component handles Supabase authentication but relies on RLS for authorization. Ensure RLS policies are correctly enforced at all endpoints and that user ID is properly validated from auth session.

Notification data URL construction concatenates strings without validation. While notifications are internally generated, URL construction should use URL() constructor for validation if URL paths can be dynamic.

recommendations: ✓ PASS: No hardcoded secrets (API keys, passwords, tokens) found in codebase. Supabase anon key is intentionally public and protected by RLS.
✓ PASS: No SQL injection risks (IndexedDB used instead of SQL; idb library provides safe query API).
✓ PASS: No XSS vulnerabilities detected. React auto-escapes by default; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML usage found.
✓ PASS: localStorage usage appropriate (non-sensitive: onboarding status, user preference, settings, notification tracking).
✓ PASS: Dependencies current and well-maintained (React 19, TypeScript ~6, @supabase/supabase-js 2.110.1).
⚠ RECOMMEND: Add explicit input validation for critical numeric inputs (dose amounts, weights, measurements) beyond TypeScript typing. Validate date formats on entry.
⚠ RECOMMEND: Verify Supabase RLS policies in supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql are correctly restrictive (owner-based row filtering for all tables).
⚠ RECOMMEND: Implement Content Security Policy (CSP) headers in Caddy config to mitigate DOM-based XSS even if escaping fails.
⚠ RECOMMEND: Run `npm audit` regularly; no vulnerable dependencies detected in current lock state.
⚠ RECOMMEND: Add CORS headers to service worker and Supabase calls to prevent cross-origin data access.
